item.title: Caker 1.0.3715
item.description:
Caker 1.0.3715

New version of Caker with improvements and bug fixes.

2026-10-17 (Git log summary - release)

  • fix: lower min requirements for Ubuntu 26.10 Server images
  • fix(ui): widen VM wizard sheet to fit content
  • fix(ui): add horizontal padding to sidebar status icon
  • fix(vm): always show Cancel button in wizard footer
  • fix(vm): Correctly apply display scaling to VNC render layer
  • refactor(vm): remove dedicated scaling logic for OCR rendering
  • fix(packer): ignore IP address detection for OpenSUSE builds
  • fix(vm): log provisioning task cancellation for easier debugging
  • fix(packer): handle opensuse installer mode selection screen in boot command
  • fix(vm): Only enable automatic display refit in normal mode
  • fix(grpc): append the image name fields instead of renumbering
  • fix(dhcp): allow missing hostname when parsing DHCP leases
  • fix(packer): replace coordinate click with keyboard shortcut in opensuse boot command
  • fix(vm): always fall back to ARP lookup regardless of network type
  • fix(ui): constrain provisioned VM preview to configured display aspect ratio
  • fix(packer): match SupportedPlatform against full image URL
  • fix(ui): tighten spacing and field widths across VM settings detail views
  • fix(ui): fix sheet sizing for editable list edit views
  • fix(ui): use circular glass buttons for editable list controls
  • fix(ui): simplify sheet sync main thread dispatch
  • fix(vm): reduce VM wizard window height
  • fix(vm): disable scrolling in wizard content and drop dead code
  • fix(vm): clean up partial download file on cancellation
  • fix(vm): enlarge VM wizard window to fit content
  • feat(vm): add localized human-readable status labels for VMs
  • feat(images): add a name field to image metadata across gRPC and UI
  • fix(vm): default import picker to first VM and fix layout
  • fix(vm): guard against nil VM and track stopping state through completion
  • refactor(home): share VM context menu between grid and detail views
  • feat(about): add PackerLite feature row and tighten About window layout
  • fix(glass): correct glass effect availability check to macOS 26.0
  • fix(networks): give Start/Stop network buttons a bordered style
  • fix(compose): give the Compose sheet a sane ideal size, not its text's height
  • docs(wiki): check-update's JSON output is --json, not --format json
  • feat(webui): list the connected caked's image catalog in the create dialog
  • chore(resources): add Ubuntu 26.10 images and update macOS 27 IPSW entries
  • fix(service): skip starting Compose DNS if already running
  • fix(caked): hide relocate in the App Store build
  • feat(caker): list the connected caked's image catalog in the VM wizard
  • feat(caked,cakectl): add check-update to report new Caker releases
  • docs(wiki): service listen disables TLS with --disable-tls
  • feat(cakectl): list --alias ids from caked over gRPC
  • fix(cakectl): register `image pull` under its real name
  • docs(wiki): fix wrong command examples in the cheat sheet
